Natural interaction for young children
blogCompareHomeCons:
Fewer tutors available nearby
Rates often higher
Scheduling can be less flexible

btFaq1A: Yes. Up to 5 students, no subscription. 15% Bronze-tier commission only when you earn.
btFaq2A: Your commission drops automatically based on annual volume: 15%->14%->13%->12% (Free) or 5%->4.5%->4%->3.5% (Pro Member), with possible retroactive commercial rebate eligibility at the Gold and Platinum tiers.
btFaq2Q: How does the sliding commission work?
btFaq3A: The annual Pro Member rebate is a conditional retroactive commercial volume rebate, calculated according to the eligible annual volume generated by the teacher on the Pratiqo marketplace. This rebate is not participation in Cours Pratiqo Inc.'s profits, a financial return, an investment, or guaranteed income. YoPratiqo and other separate self-paced products are excluded.
btFaq4A: No. You are an independent contractor. Pratiqo acts only as a technology intermediary. You set your own rates and schedule.
btFaq4Q: Am I an employee of Pratiqo?
btFaq5A: Yes. No exclusivity is required. You remain free.
btFaq5Q: Can I teach on other platforms?
btFaq6A: Yes. You set your travel radius (5-50 km) and your premium rate.

pricingWhySectionTitle: Why Pratiqo isn’t just a directory
pricingWhyCard1Body: Great for browsing profiles—booking, payment, follow-up, and disputes are often handled elsewhere.
pricingWhyCard2Body: Strong online tools, often less focused on local proximity, at-home lessons, and neighborhood context.
pricingWhyCard3Body: More structured matching—often less flexibility on choosing the teacher, pricing, and direct relationships.
pricingWhyCard4Body: Local discovery, trusted profiles, booking, payment, progress, and a resolution center in one experience.
pricingPageCommissionTitle: A commission that can decrease with your volume
pricingPageCommissionSubtitle: The more you teach on Pratiqo, the more your tier can improve.
pricingPageCommissionFootnote: Based on cumulative annual volume. The annual Pro Member rebate is a conditional retroactive commercial volume rebate, calculated according to eligible annual volume generated on the Pratiqo marketplace. It is not participation in Cours Pratiqo Inc.'s profits, a financial return, an investment, or guaranteed income. YoPratiqo and other separate self-paced products are excluded.
pricingPageCommissionDisclaimer: Displayed commissions, tiers, and benefits may vary depending on the applicable plan, promotions, eligible volume, and conditions shown on the platform. Pro Member status may improve certain visibility signals, but does not guarantee ranking, visibility, bookings, students, or income. Teachers remain independent contractors.
pricingPageBreakevenTitle: Pro makes sense when you teach regularly
pricingPageBreakevenLead: Pro Member lowers commission by 10 percentage points at the Bronze tier. Around $300 CAD in monthly lesson volume, that savings can offset the monthly Pro Member fee.
pricingPageBreakevenDisclaimer: Example only. Results depend on your volume, rates, and tier.

pricingPageValueCard3Desc: Discovery built around proximity and trust.
pricingPageValueCard4Desc: Progress and activity in one place.
pricingPageValueCard5Desc: Help when something needs a fair outcome.
pricingPageValueCard6Desc: Quality, reliability, and new features over time.
pricingPageRevenueLead: Pratiqo earns mainly when a lesson is completed and paid. Teachers can also choose Pro Member to lower commission and unlock advanced tools.
pricingPageFaq1A: No. Students don’t need a platform subscription to book lessons.
pricingPageFaq2Q: Is the listed price what I pay?
pricingPageFaq2A: Yes—for the lesson. The price shown is what you pay at checkout, without an extra platform fee from Pratiqo.
pricingPageFaq3A: Pratiqo keeps a percentage on completed, paid lessons. Your rate depends on Free vs Pro and your annual volume tier.
pricingPageFaq4Q: Why does Pratiqo charge a commission?
pricingPageFaq4A: It funds discovery, booking, payments, receipts, trust signals, and support.
pricingPageFaq5Q: When does Pro Member become worthwhile?
pricingPageFaq5A: When your lesson volume means the lower Pro commission saves more than the monthly fee—often around $300 CAD/month at the Bronze tier as a rough guide, not a promise.
pricingPageFaq6Q: Can I cancel my Pro Member membership?
pricingPageFaq6A: Yes. Pro Member costs $29.99 CAD/month, plus applicable taxes, is billed monthly in advance, and renews automatically. You can cancel any time from your dashboard or via support@pratiqo.ca; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period.
pricingPageFaq7Q: How do Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum work?
pricingPageFaq7A: Your tier reflects rolling annual lesson volume on Pratiqo. As volume grows, your rate can move to the published tiers.
pricingPageFaq8A: Timing depends on payout processing, account status, and any required checks—not a single fixed payday for everyone.
pricingPageFaq9Q: What if there’s a problem with a lesson?
pricingPageFaq9A: Use the resolution center so we can help coordinate a fair outcome.
